decision: The unit of analysis is the COUNTRY. Decided 2026-09-16. Sub-national zones are not separate entities in this program; they are aggregated up. Multi-country areas are replicated down to their members. Every stored value carries a granularity tag so the UI and any report can disclose which of the two happened.

granularity_tags.native: The source reports this exact country. No transformation.
granularity_tags.aggregated: The source reports finer zones. The country value is a weighted roll-up of them. Must record members and weighting.
granularity_tags.group: The source reports one value for an area covering several countries. That value is replicated to each member country. Must record the group id and every member. THIS IS NOT A MEASUREMENT OF THE COUNTRY.
granularity_tags.proxy: Neither of the above. A value borrowed from a different area. Last resort. Must carry a written justification.

aggregation_rule.fallback_1: generation-weighted, where load is not published per zone
aggregation_rule.fallback_2: FORBIDDEN. An unweighted mean of intensities is mathematically wrong and must never be stored. If neither load nor generation is available per zone, store the zones and leave the country value null.
aggregation_rule.rationale: Carbon intensity is a ratio, not a level. An unweighted mean gives a sparse zone the same influence as the zone carrying most of the national load. Sweden is the clearest case: SE1 is near-empty and very clean, SE3 carries Stockholm.

group_rule.behaviour: Replicate the single group value to every member country.
must_record: the source that defines the group
group_rule.ui_requirement: The portal must show a visible badge on any panel containing a group-tagged value, and the collapsible source block must name the group and its members. A report must do the same in text.
group_rule.comparison_requirement: Two countries whose values both come from the same group are NOT independent. They must never be presented as a comparison, and any ranking must collapse them into one row.

known_groups.name: Germany and Luxembourg bidding zone
known_groups.note: DE and LU share one ENTSO-E bidding zone. energy-charts nonetheless reports them separately and far apart: de 488.0 and lu 303.4 gCO2eq/kWh on 2026-09-10. Verify against ENTSO-E when the token arrives. If ENTSO-E confirms one zone, at least one of the two energy-charts series is not a grid measurement.

known_groups.name: Single Electricity Market, island of Ireland
known_groups.note: Northern Ireland trades with Ireland, not with Great Britain. NESO covers GB only.

known_groups.name: European Union aggregate
known_groups.note: energy-charts serves country=eu. 278.2 gCO2eq/kWh on 2026-09-10. Use as the comparison denominator, never as a country value.

exceptions.note: GB means GREAT BRITAIN, not the United Kingdom. Every electricity source reports Great Britain. Northern Ireland is excluded and belongs to the SEM group. energy-charts spells this country uk; map uk -> GB on ingest.
Kosovo. Not an ISO-assigned code but in common use and used by energy-charts.
